segments.normalizedSource: ```swift //#-hidden-code import UIKit import PlaygroundSupport let viewRect = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 100 , height: 400) let theView = CustomView(frame: viewRect) PlaygroundPage.current.liveView = theView //#-end-hidden-code //#-editable-code theView.markColor = UIColor.darkGray theView.isChecked = true //#-end-editable-code ```
